text:
marta: Quick heads-up — Selene Metrics (account: selene-prod) is doing a LATAM launch tonight at 22:00 local. They need: (1) latam-south peering, (2) a header-based allowlist for their Host: api.selene.com, and (3) a temporary route-level QPS surge for 6h.

devin: Can you confirm target QPS and whether this is a regional-only lift?

marta: Target is 80 QPS steady with bursts to 120 QPS for 6h. Region-only: latam-south routes only. Customer also asked for a short TTL — auto-revoke after 6h. They've flagged this as high-priority but said they understand auto-revoke.

leo: Couple of asks: we should do header-based allowlist rather than broad CIDR if they can send Host or x-cust-id. Also prefer applying rate_override on route `latam-south-1` scoped to account to avoid global changes.

marta: They can set header x-customer-id: selene-123. Good to know. Also, AM raised renewal concern if we miss this window. Scheduling enablement call at T-30m to confirm metrics and cache knobs.

devin: Infra action (example payloads):

```
POST /internal/admin/allowlists
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account": "selene-prod",
  "type": "header",
  "header": "x-customer-id",
  "values": ["selene-123"],
  "expires_at": "2026-03-23T03:00:00Z",
  "note": "Selene launch -> header allowlist, auto-revoke 6h"
}
```

```
POST /internal/admin/rate_overrides
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "route": "latam-south-1",
  "account": "selene-prod",
  "qps": 120,
  "duration": "6h",
  "scope": "account",
  "reason": "launch spike allowance"
}
```

ops-bot: Job queued: job/992100 for header-allowlist + rate_override (canary -> latam-south-1-a).

devin: Rolled out to canary (latam-south-1-a). Monitoring windows: 15m for basic health, then 45m for sustained checks. Alerts set: error_rate > 1.5% OR p95_lat > 300ms -> initiate rollback. Also watch token consumption spikes — set token-rate alert at +40% baseline.

marta: Please log this in CRM with the renewal flag and note that we provided KV-cache recommendations during enablement (they'll prefix repeated prompts).

leo: I'll add a tiny rollback playbook to the sequence: (1) revoke header allowlist, (2) delete rate_override, (3) notify AM + customer channel, (4) revert any temporary DNS peering. Also set a scheduled auto-revoke at the expires_at.

marta: Thanks — if canary looks good after 15m, push to latam-south-1-b. I'll notify the customer and the AM.

devin: Canary healthy at +20m, p95=120ms, errors=0.8%, token-rate +18%. Proceeding to push to latam-south-1-b.

ops-bot: Job/992100 completed: allowlist + rate_override applied to latam-south-1-a & latam-south-1-b.

marta: :tada: Sent confirmation to Selene and updated the renewal flag. Enablement note added: "KV cache hints enabled; expect cost reduction on repeated prompts."

leo: Added runbook entry and scheduled revoke job. Closing thread after expiry.

(threads end)
